changes.before: At the end of each reading-room shift, the volunteer should count returned audio players, check that each is in its numbered sleeve
changes.after: Count returned players, check numbered sleeves
changes.reason: The rewrite drops the end-of-shift timing and weakens the check that each player is in its own numbered sleeve.

changes.before: When all devices are present, the volunteer may initial the check after recording the count.
changes.after: Initial only if all devices are present and counted.
changes.reason: The source permits initialling after recording the count; the rewrite makes initialling sound mandatory when its condition is met and does not clearly retain the after-recording order.

changes.before: the manager is covering only until the lead returns, and should not be asked to authorise disposal or replacement.
changes.after: manager cannot authorise disposal or replacement.
changes.reason: The rewrite changes an instruction not to ask the manager to authorise disposal or replacement into a claim that the manager lacks authority.
